title: Heat dispersion laws in smooth compact manifolds
summary: Given a Lipschitz conductor $K$ in the smooth compact Riemannian $2\le n$-manifold $(M,g)$, such a half generic heat dispersion law $$ {\rm H^d}_{p,\varPhi,\varPsi}(K,M)=2^{-1} {\rm H^d}_{Δ_p,\varPhi,\varPsi}(K,M) $$ is not only newly-established via Theorem 1.1 but also deeply-explored through not only Proposition 3.1 (a comparison law for the generic heat dispersion) but also Proposition 3.2 (a recycling law for the quasilinear Laplace-Robin eigenvalue).
